name: Dashboard — status do launcher, MCP e Ollama são exibidos

planSteps.description: Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:7777/ and wait for the dashboard to load
The server status bar shows either 'Launcher ativo' or 'Launcher offline' text
The MCP status badge displays 'Online', 'Desconectado' or 'Indisponível'
The Ollama status badge displays 'Online', 'Sem modelos' or 'Offline'
The CPU, RAM Livre, Disco Livre and Uptime metric cards are visible with values or '--'
